{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rakata Cryo-Shock''' was a type of [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan grenade]] produced by [[Wynz-Tek/Legends|Wynz-Tek]]. During the [[battle for the Black Hole]], the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal [[Kovic]] used a variety of Wynz-Tek grenades, including Rakata Cryo-Shocks, in battle.
